Do you provide any toolboxes, wheel repair kits, or a minimum set of tools?

For standard rentals, we usually rely on the extensive network of local tire shops (Sửa Xe) found everywhere in Vietnam, where repairs take 10-30 minutes. However, if you are planning a long-distance trip or it is crucial for your peace of mind, we can provide a minimum set of tools and a wheel repair kit upon request.
Where can I go? Only in Nha Trang?
You can travel throughout the entire territory of Vietnam! Our bikes are maintained for long-haul journeys beyond the city limits.
Of course! Automatic scooters are easy to learn. We provide free 15-30 min training. We guarantee you will be able to drive!
What equipment is included in the price?
The rental price includes the motorcycle/scooter and a protective helmet. For longer trips, we can also provide rain ponchos and luggage straps to secure your bags.
What should be left as collateral?
To rent a bike, you need to leave any form of valid identification (ID card, driver's license, or passport) and a cash deposit starting from $200.
Who pays for motorcycle breakdowns or damages?
Anything that happens due to the client's fault (falls, accidents, or physical damage) is paid for by the client upon repair. Standard wear and tear or internal mechanical issues are covered by us.
Can you provide any city-related advice (other than rental)?
Absolutely! We are happy to be your local guides. We can tell you about the best hidden waterfalls, the most delicious local food spots, secret bars, and current events happening in the city. 🍔🍻💃
Does the tour around Dalat include a visit to the waterfalls?
Yes! You can easily ride to Ba Ho Waterfalls or the scenic passes toward Da Lat and Cam Ranh.
Do you only rent scooters, or are there other adventures?

We are experts in adventure! In addition to scooter rentals, we organize professional Enduro Tours through the jungle and mountains. If you want something different, like the Dalat Canyoning Tour (waterfall rappelling), we can also connect you with our most trusted partners. 🧗👍
Is it possible to combine a bike trip with a coffee tour?

This is a great idea! You can ride your rental bike through the vast coffee plantations of the Central Highlands, see how the beans are grown, and taste authentic Vietnamese coffee right at the source. ☕🌿
Do you have powerful motorcycles available?

Yes, we have powerful motorcycles in our fleet for more experienced riders. If you have specific requirements or need a high-performance bike for your trip, please contact us directly and we will find the best option for you! 😉💸
